#!/bin/sh
# gamedash-managed Enshrouded server — generated by provision().
# Settings: <ROOT>/installs/enshrouded/gamedash-servers/test/enshrouded_server.json
. <ROOT>/secrets.conf
# keep the join + admin passwords in step with the ones set in GameDash
python3 - "<ROOT>/installs/enshrouded/gamedash-servers/test/enshrouded_server.json" "$GAME_SERVER_PASSWORD" "$GAME_ADMIN_PASSWORD" <<'SYNC'
import json, sys
p, join, admin = sys.argv[1:4]
d = json.load(open(p, encoding="utf-8"))
for g in d.get("userGroups", []):
    if g.get("name") == "Admin":
        g["password"] = admin
    elif g.get("name") == "Friend":
        g["password"] = join
json.dump(d, open(p, "w", encoding="utf-8"), indent="\t")
SYNC
export WINEPREFIX="<ROOT>/home/.wine-gd-enshrouded-test"
export WINEDEBUG=-all
export WINEDLLOVERRIDES="mscoree,mshtml="   # no Mono/Gecko install prompts (headless)
# Run headless: Wine would otherwise open a console window on the desktop
# session (unsetting DISPLAY alone isn't enough — it falls back to Wayland).
unset DISPLAY
export WAYLAND_DISPLAY=wayland-none
cd "<ROOT>/installs/enshrouded/gamedash-servers/test" || exit 1
exec wine ./enshrouded_server.exe
